name: Immortal King's Daily Life
overview: High school student Wang Ling, the reincarnation of an immortal king, seals his powers to live a normal life. After meeting heiress Sun Rong, he’s drawn into unexpected conflicts and must navigate between staying low-key and using his abilities. Along the way, he learns to protect those he cares about, balancing ordinary life with extraordinary power in a humorous and action-packed campus adventure.
